name: spring-boot-review
description: Multi-phase analysis of Java Spring Boot applications producing a curated audit report with scored findings across 8 categories: security, performance, code quality, configuration, dependencies, error handling, testing, and API design. Optionally includes Spring Boot 4.x migration readiness audit. Uses scratchpad files to offload findings from context during long-running analysis. v2.0 adds deterministic re-run consistency: fixed file manifests, deduplication, pre-computed scoring, heartbeat tracking, and sharding for large projects.
author: Spring Boot Review Contributors

graphify.description: Pre-indexes codebase to reduce token usage by 60-84%

node.description: For PDF generation via npx md-to-pdf

categories.description: Comma-separated subset: security, performance, code-quality, configuration, dependencies, error-handling, testing, api-design
